next_step: POC kickoff (small-scale batch embed job) + Dedicated pricing recap
notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (B2B knowledge base + search & recommendations). Evaluating Hosted API first for rapid prototyping; plan to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost if POC hits targets. Primary driver: improve semantic search recall & reduce query latency for customer-facing product search.

Discovery highlights: - Product: multi-tenant knowledge platform used by ~350 customers, datasets vary 10k-2M docs/customer. - Current infra: embeddings produced with open-source model -> stored in Pinecone; they run nightly batch jobs (ETL -> embed -> upsert). Concern about cost and scaling as customers grow. - Team: small infra + ML infra (6 engineers), product manager pushing for better recall and vector DB consolidation.

Requirements/targets: - Embedding throughput: need to embed 1M docs overnight (8-12 hour window) during POC. Need per-second embedding throughput estimate + recommended batching configs. - Query latency target: 70-200ms P95 for semantic search (top-k retrieval + rerank). - Concurrency/throughput: search QPS expected burst 150-250 QPS; steady 30-50 QPS. - Cost sensitivity: want cost modeling for hosted vs Dedicated (break-even for ~45M tokens/mo). - Vector DB: currently Pinecone; evaluating leaving Pinecone vs using RedisVector/Weaviate in-house. Need connector reliability and replication guidance. - Batch jobs: support for bulk embeddings API, resumable jobs, idempotency keys, and recommended retries/backoff.

Security & compliance notes: - Must support SSO/SAML for admin console. - Audit logging and KMS integration required for Dedicated/Private. - Data residency: EMEA customers require EU region availability for embeddings storage.

Engagement timeline & activity (bulleted): - 2025-02-18: Intro call (Maya + Rafael) — high-level use case, asked for sample throughput numbers. - 2025-02-25: Hosted API demo (Fireflies ff_2025-02-25_amberfield-demo). Demo focused on embeddings + semantic search flow, quickstart with SDK. Customer liked streaming and eval hooks. - 2025-03-03: Technical deep-dive with infra team — discussed batch pipeline, Pinecone connector, retry semantics. Took notes on expected doc sizes and shard strategy. - 2025-03-10: Cost modeling session — asked for Dedicated pricing scenarios and reserved capacity options. - 2025-03-15: Pre-POC sync — agreed POC scope: (a) run nightly embed job of 1M docs on Hosted API; (b) run simulated QPS 200 for 2 hours to measure latency and tail; (c) integrate Redwood SDK to current Pinecone workflow and compare end-to-end cost.

POC deliverables (agreed): - Hosted API test plan + scripts for bulk embedding and concurrent search load. - Throughput benchmark report (tokens/sec, embeddings/sec, batch size effects). - Recommendation doc: move-to-dedicated threshold (tokens/month + concurrency), batching params, caching suggestions. - Dedicated pricing proposal and an optional reserved capacity layout.

Risks & open questions (shorthand): - "How does Redwood handle idempotent bulk upserts?" (careful about partial failures). - Need explicit SLA for Dedicated for p95 latency under 200ms at 200 QPS. - Legal: DPA + standard security appendix needed before Dedicated procurement. - Vector DB: want a validated connector for Pinecone and recommendations if they want to migrate to self-hosted vector store.

Quotes from PM: "If we can cut search latency by half and reduce embedding run cost 30% we'll justify Dedicated spend".

Next steps (short): - Rafael to deliver Hosted API bulk-embed scripts + estimated run cost by 2025-03-21. - Maya to schedule POC kickoff with Amberfield infra on 2025-03-24. - Sales to prep Dedicated pricing deck (Lena).

Short-term asks from customer: batching best-practices doc, sample scripts for parallel bulk embedding, Pinecone connector checklist, preliminary Dedicated pricing grid.

CRM notes style: fragments, quick bullets, some repetition ok. Logged by Maya Thompson on 2025-03-18.
